unit: WF4 Integrity Guard detail order preserved across ranking
description: The ranking fix must change the HEADLINE, never the LIST: even though integrity_code names the LATER-pushed, higher-severity conflict (DUPLICATE_ACTION_ID_FIELD_MISMATCH, rank 0), the emitted integrity_detail array stays in the guard's push order — the EARLIER-pushed DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY (rank 1) is still detail[0]. That order is what protects Build Integrity Halt Notice's MAX_DETAIL slice and its deterministic event_id seed, both of which hash and render the exact sequence. This scenario feeds the halt notice the exact halt item a DRAFT-route guard would emit after the fix and pins the order with a byte-exact event_id plus the two rendered detail lines in that order.
why_it_exists: harness/FINDINGS.md section 1 fix explicitly contracts the list: 'Rank a COPY. conflicts (and therefore integrity_detail) keeps register order, so the halt notice, its MAX_DETAIL slice and its deterministic event_id seed are all byte-for-byte what they were before this fix.' No existing scenario checks that property: the two guard scenarios (wf4-integrity-severity-headlines-field-mismatch, wf4-integrity-conflict-count-distinct-ids) assert only the headline code and the count — the integrity-guard adapter has no detail keys — and the two notice scenarios (wf4-integrity-halt-notice-counts, wf4-integrity-halt-notice-fallback) assert counts but never pin an event_id or the order of the rendered detail lines. A future change that sorted integrity_detail by severity would keep all those checks green while silently re-ordering the owner-facing slice and the Events row id. This scenario closes that gap by pinning event_id = EVT-INTEGRITY-fnv1a exactly over [DIK, FIELD_MISMATCH] and asserting the reply shows the DIK line before the FIELD_MISMATCH line.

items.integrity_reason: More than one Action row could be selected for matter MAT-20260101-002. I will not choose between them, and I will not draft, approve, write state or send until a human decides which row is the action. 1 ambiguous action(s) found, reported as 2 conflict record(s).

expect.reply_contains:
Conflicting records (1):
  DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY  key MAT-20260101-002|001
  DUPLICATE_ACTION_ID_FIELD_MISMATCH  action ACT-20260101-002-001

assertions: integrity_code names the LATER-pushed, higher-severity conflict (DUPLICATE_ACTION_ID_FIELD_MISMATCH, rank 0) while integrity_detail still leads with the EARLIER-pushed DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY (rank 1): ranking changed the headline only, never the list
the integrity_detail array is exactly [DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, DUPLICATE_ACTION_ID_FIELD_MISMATCH] — the guard's push order, which is the register order
the deterministic event_id is pinned byte-for-byte to the seed over that exact sequence: any reordering of integrity_detail changes seed['detail-code:action_id chain'] and fails
the MAX_DETAIL slice renders the two detail lines in that same order inside the reply, DIK first, FIELD_MISMATCH second
halt_conflict_count is the guard's distinct count (1) and halt_conflict_record_count carries the raw records (2), so the notice still agrees with the reason string
halt_code and halt_stage classify the item as a pre-draft Integrity Guard halt
the passthrough fields survive onto the notice item
